name: cmd_segment_model_download
description: Download AI Mask Model (command `segment.model.download`). Params: {acknowledged: true} — download the SAM 3 model (about 3.4 GB, Meta's SAM License, not LightCraft's) in the background, from the configured mirrors; only after the user agreed to it. Watch segment.model.status; segment.model.cancel stops it (it resumes later) → {started, installed, downloading}.
